financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of 5,000,000 shares with concurrent private placement of warrants, at $2.00 per share and warrant. Net of the $700,000 placement agent fee and before other expenses. The documents give only an expected closing date, not a confirmed close.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The closing of the Offering is expected to occur on or about August 1, 2024.

warrants.quote: The Warrants have an exercise price of $2.00 per share and will be exercisable immediately for a term of five and one-half years following the date of issuance.
